_readme: Camp-Buzz Multiplier input. This is the ONLY place training-camp news enters the pipeline.
Refresh it by asking Cursor's agent in chat (see README.md); the core script never searches the web itself.
score: -2..+2. +2 = multiple beat writers reporting a clear role/battle win, +1 = positive but limited,
0 = no notable camp news, -1/-2 = mirrored negatives. Multiplier is capped at +/-8%.
Every entry MUST have a source; entries without one are dropped, because unsourced camp adjustments are not allowed.
Players absent from this file are treated as neutral (0).
Season-ending absences belong in known_absences.csv, not here -- they are a games count, not a PPG nudge.
SCOPE: all rounds, early through late. Players are scored wherever there is genuine sourced camp
news, with no rank filter. Where reporting was only a press-conference listing or a generic 'had a
good practice' with no role, health or usage signal, the player is deliberately left neutral rather
than given a number the reporting does not support.

players.source: Sports Illustrated Raiders; Raider Ramble; Just Blog Baby camp coverage
players.note: Multiple outlets on a Year 2 breakout: new HC Klint Kubiak's wide-zone scheme, upgraded line (Linderbaum, Burford), an expanded route tree with slot usage, and an offseason conditioning overhaul.

players.source: Raiders.com training camp notebook (7/31) and camp updates (8/4)
players.note: Back to full health after an injury-hit 2025 and 'the main target every time he stepped on the field', with red-zone touchdowns from Kirk Cousins on consecutive practices.

players.source: Alaina Getzenberg, ESPN; BuffaloBills.com Day 5; Syracuse.com camp observations
players.note: The standout play of Bills camp - a 50-yard TD beating triple coverage. Shakir called the Allen connection 'unreal'; Allen said the chemistry clicked once he stopped aiming throws.

players.source: Jeremy Fowler, ESPN (via 106.7 The Fan / Commanders Wire); Hogs Haven
players.note: Fowler: 'McLaurin looked like himself again' after a 2025 wrecked by a hold-in and injuries; he and Jayden Daniels are visibly back on the same page.

players.source: Adam Slivon, Pewter Report; OC Zac Robinson presser (via Yahoo Sports)
players.note: Most carries in Friday's practice and a full participant after an injury-hit 2025; Robinson called him 'a stud' and has him shouldering the bulk of the carries.

players.source: Ben Johnson presser via NFL.com; Chicago Sun-Times; Shaw Local
players.note: Multiple outlets on a Year 2 breakout; HC Ben Johnson compared his competitive edge directly to Amon-Ra St. Brown. Chicago moved on from DJ Moore partly to open these targets.

players.source: Connor Hughes, SNY (via NBC Sports player news)
players.note: 'Clear Skattebo is the top back' - first up in almost every running drill and handling the majority of carries. Caveat: Tracy and Singletary are preferred in the passing game.

players.source: Mike Triplett, New Orleans Football (via NBC Sports); Saints Wire
players.note: Fully practising after the spring hamstring recurrence and with the first-team offense since day one; slated as the Saints' WR2.

players.source: Seattle Times camp notebook; Seahawks.com Day 8 observations
players.note: Macdonald made deep balls to Shaheed an explicit camp goal; he took a 55-yard TD from Darnold as the play of the day and looks set for a far bigger role.

players.source: Jane Slater, NFL Network (via The Big Lead)
players.note: Reported to split lead-back reps with David Montgomery rather than sitting behind him - a major role upgrade for a player going in the last third of drafts.

players.source: Sports Illustrated / OnSI Browns camp week 1 review
players.note: 'Undisputed highlight' of week one and the Browns' biggest camp winner, winning contested balls as the true X receiver Cleveland lacked.

players.source: Will Ragatz, Bring Me The Sports (Day 7); ESPN camp intel; Star Tribune; NFL.com position battles
players.note: Taking the lion's share of first-team reps and separating from J.J. McCarthy; Day 7 described as a turning point after a run of accurate deep balls.

players.source: Rams.com Day 9 training camp observations
players.note: Repeatedly cited for highlight plays through the open-practice portion of camp.

players.source: ESPN 2026 hold-in tracker
players.note: Ended his hold-in with a three-year extension ($51M guaranteed) and is back in camp, removing the holdout risk that shadowed his summer.

players.source: Star Tribune; Will Ragatz, Bring Me The Sports (Day 7)
players.note: After a slow start to camp, his best day yet: five catches plus a contested situational touchdown over two defenders. Building rapport with Kyler Murray.

players.source: The Devy Royale NFL training camp roundup (7/21-8/01)
players.note: 'Locked and loaded as one of the focal points of the offense'; ceiling tied to Arizona QB play.

players.source: Joe Person, The Athletic; Panthers.com camp observations
players.note: Cleared his spring foot issue and practising in full; Canales calls him the offense's 'focal point' and is moving him into the slot more.

players.source: DallasCowboys.com practice points; Sports Illustrated camp review
players.note: Signed the franchise tag without drama and looks sharp opposite Lamb; part of a clear offensive bounceback day in the second padded practice.

players.source: DallasCowboys.com practice points (second padded practice)
players.note: Named among the offensive standouts in a bounceback padded practice after the defense won day one.

players.source: Ravens camp reporting (via AFC North camp roundups)
players.note: Signed a four-year, $140M extension, removing contract risk; sat out only the single practice tied to signing.

players.source: Bengals.com Day 6 observations
players.note: Featured in red-zone work with Burrow, who has publicly targeted a 48-TD season. Offsetting note: DJ Turner II has won a share of reps against both Bengals starters.

players.source: Alaina Getzenberg, ESPN Bills camp intel
players.note: Reigning rushing champion, and the Buffalo backfield is 'noticeably more involved as pass catchers' under new OC Pete Carmichael Jr. - a PPR-relevant usage shift.

players.source: BuffaloBills.com Day 3 and Day 5; ESPN camp intel
players.note: Sharp throughout camp and has built an immediate connection with DJ Moore, giving Buffalo the deep threat the passing game lacked.

players.source: Chiefs camp reporting (via AFC West camp roundups)
players.note: Showing high-level form on a lighter frame at 37 after signing a one-year deal, though long-term retirement speculation persists.

players.source: Chargers camp reporting (via AFC West camp roundups)
players.note: Drawing attention for a deep-threat rapport with Justin Herbert.

players.source: Matthew Lenix, Blogging The Boys; DallasCowboys.com practice points
players.note: Best practice of camp in the second padded session - seam catch, one-handed grab and a TD - and looks more explosive after a mixed 2025.

players.source: DallasCowboys.com practice points (second padded practice)
players.note: Clear bounceback day after the defense dominated the first padded practice; on the same page with Ferguson in the quick passing game.

players.source: Will Ragatz, Bring Me The Sports (Vikings Day 7)
players.note: 'Looked really good' with real burst on a cutback that may have gone for a touchdown.

players.source: Kevin Bowen, 1075thefan.com (via CBS Sports); Sports Illustrated Colts
players.note: Seventh-round rookie holding a slight edge over DJ Giddens for the Colts' RB2 job, splitting first-team reps with Jonathan Taylor and breaking off long runs.

players.source: Raiders.com training camp notebook (7/31)
players.note: Workload increased on Day 3 alongside Nailor and Benson as the Raiders spread targets beyond Bowers.

players.source: Ravens camp reporting (via AFC North camp roundups)
players.note: Rookie receiver emerging as a camp standout, consistently praised for playmaking.

players.source: Mark Kaboly, 93.7 The Fan; Chris Adamski, Pittsburgh Tribune-Review
players.note: Two beat writers had him as RB1 over Jaylen Warren on first-team reps, but the official Aug 5 depth chart still lists him RB2, so the role win is not clean. Kaboly projected roughly 65-70% of snaps.

players.source: Camp depth-chart roundup (via NFL.com position battles coverage)
players.note: Holding the New England lead role with TreVeyon Henderson reported as the clear RB2 behind him.

players.source: Denver camp depth-chart reporting (via camp roundups)
players.note: Operating as the Broncos' starter with RJ Harvey behind him as RB2.

players.source: Yahoo Sports TE camp preview; FTN Fantasy TE tiers
players.note: In line for a larger share of the Indianapolis passing game after Michael Pittman Jr. was traded, with no clear replacement brought in. Upside tied to Daniel Jones' health.

players.source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution camp report
players.note: New staff (Stefanski/Rees) leaned heavily on tight ends in Cleveland, where two TEs cleared an 11% target share; Pitts signed a three-year extension after a strong 2025 finish.

players.source: ChicagoBears.com camp feature
players.note: 'Picked up right where he left off' after leading the Bears in receiving as a rookie, though Chicago's target competition is crowded.

players.source: Yahoo Sports TE camp preview / Browns camp reporting
players.note: Cleared for full participation after groin surgery and still a focal point off 107 targets in 2025; capped by Cleveland's unresolved quarterback situation.

players.source: FTN Fantasy TE tiers; Detroit camp reporting
players.note: Projected to benefit from new OC Drew Petzing, whose history with Trey McBride points to heavy tight end target volume.

players.source: Adam Slivon, Pewter Report (via RotoWire)
players.note: Used primarily as a receiving back and building early rapport with Mayfield; led the Steelers with 73 catches in 2025 and owns a defined passing-down niche.

players.source: Blitz Sports Media camp risers roundup (HC Liam Coen quote)
players.note: Coen said he expects a 'big year' from Tuten, with camp reports supporting an expanded role.

players.source: Mike Kaye, The Charlotte Observer; HC Dave Canales (via FantasyPros)
players.note: Took first-team reps after two ACL tears; Canales said he 'looks like the guy that I remember'.

players.source: PackersTalk camp week 1 stock up/stock down
players.note: Consistently generating highlight plays through the first week of Green Bay camp.

players.source: The Devy Royale NFL training camp roundup (7/21-8/01)
players.note: One of Arizona's most consistent camp performers, building QB trust ahead of Marvin Harrison Jr.

players.source: Blitz Sports Media camp risers roundup
players.note: Identified by camp reports as the quarterback's go-to receiver in Jacksonville practices.

players.source: Chris Adamski, Pittsburgh Tribune-Review (via X)
players.note: 'Roman Wilson is WR3, well ahead of Germie Bernard' four practices into camp.

players.source: Blitz Sports Media camp risers roundup
players.note: Reported as Mahomes' favourite practice target, working consistently with the first-team offense.

players.source: ESPN hold-in tracker; Yahoo Sports
players.note: Has taken most of the first-team RB reps in week one of camp while Jahmyr Gibbs holds in.

players.source: Yahoo Sports NFL training camp injury report
players.note: In line for early-season TE work with George Kittle opening camp on the PUP list.

players.source: Theo Mackie, AZ Central; Tyler Drake, AZ Sports (via FantasyPros)
players.note: Love and Allgeier traded off first-team series while reporters had not yet seen Conner practising - a clear negative on his workload security.

players.source: Yahoo Sports camp injury report; PhillyVoice 2026 opponent tracker
players.note: Torn Achilles in the wildcard round; opened camp on the PUP list. Beat reports suggest a realistic Week 1 target, but staying on PUP past cutdown would cost at least four games.

players.source: PhillyVoice 2026 opponent injury/suspension tracker
players.note: Torn ACL in last season's divisional round; opened 2026 camp on the PUP list.

players.source: Martin Frank, Delaware Online / Eagles camp observations
players.note: Out with a hamstring injury - his second this offseason after missing the last two weeks of spring. A recurring soft-tissue issue for a first-round rookie still earning a role.

players.source: ESPN 2026 hold-in tracker; Yahoo Sports
players.note: Contract hold-in: missed a sixth straight practice as of Aug 4 and said only 'time will tell' on his return. Contract-driven rather than performance, and he remains the clear Detroit RB1.

players.source: Sports Illustrated Colts; Kevin Bowen, 1075thefan.com
players.note: Indianapolis wants to reduce his workload to keep him fresh, and the RB2 winner is expected to hold 'a bigger role than in years past'. Pass protection is cited as a Taylor weakness on third down.

players.source: AFC East camp roundups (Dolphins QB situation)
players.note: Miami is in a rebuild with Malik Willis at quarterback, a meaningful downgrade to the offensive environment around him.

players.source: ESPN (Mickey Loomis and Kellen Moore comments)
players.note: Fully cleared medically after starting the offseason on blood thinners for a blood clot, but sat out 7-on-7 and 11-on-11 work; Kellen Moore confirmed the absence is contract-related.

players.source: Giants camp reporting (via NFC East camp roundups); FantasyPros ADP notes
players.note: Limited by a knee injury. He avoided the PUP list and is expected for Week 1, but the recovery from a complicated ACL plus a second procedure argues for a slow ramp.

players.source: Martin Frank, Delaware Online / Eagles camp observations
players.note: Sat out with a hamstring injury; a league source indicated no long-term concern and a cautious rehab.

players.source: Kevin O'Connell presser via Vikings.com; Bring Me The Sports Day 7
players.note: Jammed thumb, imaging clean and 'nothing to be concerned about', but ran routes on air without catching passes for several days.

players.source: Will Ragatz, Bring Me The Sports (Day 7); ESPN camp intel
players.note: Losing the Minnesota quarterback competition to Kyler Murray, who is taking the lion's share of first-team reps.

players.source: Jane Slater, NFL Network (via The Big Lead)
players.note: Expected to split lead-back reps with Woody Marks rather than inherit the workhorse role many assumed after the trade to Houston. Keeps short-yardage and goal-line work.

players.source: Camp depth-chart roundup (via NFL.com position battles coverage)
players.note: Reported as the clear RB2 behind Rhamondre Stevenson in New England.

players.source: Denver camp depth-chart reporting (via camp roundups)
players.note: Functioning as RB2 behind J.K. Dobbins, with Coleman/McLaughlin/Badie competing beneath him.

players.source: Camp depth-chart roundup (via NFL.com position battles coverage)
players.note: Competing for touches inside a Cleveland rotation rather than holding a clear lead-back role.

players.source: The Devy Royale NFL training camp roundup (7/21-8/01)
players.note: Making plays but drops and inconsistency persist; Michael Wilson currently looks the more dependable option for Arizona.

players.source: Sports Illustrated / OnSI Browns camp week 1 review
players.note: Contested-catch and consistency issues showing up in camp while fellow rookie Denzel Boston has clearly outperformed him.

players.source: Chris Ballard presser via AP / Yahoo Sports
players.note: Opened camp on the PUP list with an ankle injury. Ballard expects him practising within two weeks and playing Week 1, and he signed a four-year $114M extension this offseason.

players.source: Yahoo Sports NFL training camp injury report
players.note: Off the PUP list and practising again after a mid-2025 torn ACL, but reported to still have 'a lot of work to do' before Week 1.

players.source: Roto Street Journal 2026 camp news tracker (8/1-8/3)
players.note: Quad injury and on the camp injury list, against a long history of hamstring-related absences.

players.source: Mark Kaboly, 93.7 The Fan; Chris Adamski, Pittsburgh Tribune-Review
players.note: Lost first-team reps to Rico Dowdle early in camp, though Pittsburgh's official Aug 5 depth chart still lists Warren as RB1, so the negative is partly offset.

players.source: Roto Street Journal 2026 camp news tracker (8/1-8/3)
players.note: Calf injury; missing his chance to win a starting spot and build rapport with Brock Purdy.

players.source: Roto Street Journal 2026 camp news tracker (8/1-8/3)
players.note: Ribs injury; on the 49ers camp injury list.

players.source: Dave Holcomb, Heavy.com (Mike McCarthy presser)
players.note: McCarthy talked up Dowdle and Warren but notably did not vouch for Johnson, a regular healthy scratch late in 2025.

players.source: Dan Campbell presser (via Yahoo Sports / ESPN)
players.note: Broke his nose in practice on Aug 3 and will miss time, opening reps for other Detroit backs.

players.source: ESPN (via FantasyPros camp fallers)
players.note: Slated as Atlanta's Week 1 starter but dealing with an undisclosed back 'flare-up' limiting his camp work.
